input.question: Until when can a Belgian client send its payroll variables (overtime, bonuses) so they are processed in the current month's payroll, and through which channel?

trust_reasons: Last modified less than 3 months ago

trust_reasons: Last modified less than 4 months ago

trust_reasons: Last modified less than 6 months ago

key_points_of_the_answer: deadline: the 18th of the month at 12:00
channel: client portal, Variables module, no email
after the deadline: postponed to the following month (urgent exception with written approval of the team lead, if DOC-003 is used)
expected.to_check: The answer combines DOC-001 and DOC-002 (and possibly DOC-003) without inventing anything.
